description_en: Cancels a directory quota for a file system
description_zh: 取消文件系统的目录配额
name: CancelDirQuota

parameters.help_en: The absolute path of the directory in the file system
parameters.help_zh: 目录在文件系统中的绝对路径
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en:
The user type.

Valid values:

Uid: user ID
Gid: user group ID
AllUsers: all users
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型。

取值：

Uid：用户ID
Gid：用户所属组ID
AllUsers：所有用户
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The UID or GID to cancel.

This parameter is required and valid only when UserType is set to Uid or Gid.

Examples:

To cancel the quota for the user whose UID is 500, set UserType to Uid and UserId to 500.
To cancel the quota for the user group whose GID is 100, set UserType to Gid and UserId to 100
parameters.help_zh:
要取消的Uid或Gid。

当UserType=Uid或Gid时必填且有意义。

例如：

要取消Uid=500的用户，则UserType填Uid，UserId填500。
要取消Gid=100的用户组，则UserType填Gid，UserId填100
parameters.name: user_id

Success.description_en:
The request status.

Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求状态。

取值：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
